featured_projects.title: Gourmet Bistro Multi-Agent AI Customer Service & Ordering System
featured_projects.github_description: Multi-agent LangChain restaurant assistant with Qdrant/Supabase RAG, Google Sheets dynamic pricing, order management with 5-min grace cancellation, and Telegram kitchen dispatch.
featured_projects.business_impact: Enforces business rules (phone validation, delivery checks, 5-min cancellation grace period) while reducing customer service workload by 80%.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Multi-Agent router delegating to Front Desk, Menu/FAQ RAG specialist, Order Creator with pricing lookup, Order Modifier/Cancellation engine, and Kitchen Telegram Dispatcher.

featured_projects.title: Apple Financial & Product Intelligence RAG Agent v2
featured_projects.github_description: Autonomous RAG chatbot indexing Apple 10-K filings and products using OpenAI embeddings, Qdrant vector store, and conversational memory with hybrid reranking.
featured_projects.business_impact: Eliminates manual 10-K report parsing and product lookup, providing instant answers grounded strictly in verified corporate documents.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Vector store retriever connected to Qdrant collection with cosine distance metric, OpenAI embedding model, conversational memory buffer, and prompt template grounding.

featured_projects.title: Upwork AI Automated Proposal & Job Lead Scraper

featured_projects.business_impact: Saves 10+ hours per week on freelance job applications while increasing response rates through high-precision custom proposal drafting.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Periodic/webhook trigger activating Apify actor, JSON parsing, GPT-4 semantic analysis of client pain points, and structured proposal generation.

featured_projects.title: Pizza Delivery Conversational Commerce Bot with MSSQL Persistence

featured_projects.business_impact: Frictionless ordering directly inside Telegram with cart recovery even if user disconnects.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Telegram trigger feeding natural language queries to OpenRouter AI agent, executing dynamic cart tools, and persisting order states into relational MSSQL tables.

featured_projects.title: Emaar Towers Real Estate AI Lead Qualification Agent

featured_projects.architecture_summary: Inbound Telegram inquiry parsed by conversational LLM, budget and down-payment qualification, spreadsheet CRM insertion, and VIP agent routing.

featured_projects.title: Google Drive Automated PDF Ingestion & Qdrant Vector Indexer
featured_projects.github_description: Event-driven ETL pipeline monitoring Google Drive for PDFs, extracting and chunking text, generating embeddings, and upserting vectors into Qdrant for RAG.
featured_projects.business_impact: Completely automates knowledge base synchronization; new enterprise PDFs in Drive become queryable within seconds.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Drive polling/trigger -> binary PDF retrieval -> character-aware chunking -> embedding vector generation -> Qdrant collection upsert.

featured_projects.title: Customer Feedback Sentiment Classifier & Real-Time Alert Agent
featured_projects.github_description: Real-time customer feedback sentiment classifier logging sentiment scores to Google Sheets and triggering instant priority alerts for negative reviews.
featured_projects.business_impact: Reduces negative review escalation response time from hours to under 60 seconds, mitigating customer churn.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Webhook input -> LLM sentiment scoring (Positive, Neutral, Negative) -> Google Sheets audit log -> conditional Telegram dispatch on negative feedback.

featured_projects.title: Telegram to Notion AI Knowledge Curation ETL Pipeline

featured_projects.architecture_summary: Telegram trigger -> URL extraction -> metadata scraping -> AI summary + tagging -> Notion page creation.

featured_projects.title: Serverless GPT-OSS-20B HuggingFace Inference with Cold-Start Resilience
featured_projects.github_description: Cloud LLM inference workflow integrating HuggingFace API with automatic 503 cold-start retries, Wait node backoff, and robust response parsing.
featured_projects.business_impact: Zero-infrastructure serverless LLM deployment capable of handling model cold-starts gracefully without dropped requests.
featured_projects.architecture_summary: Chat trigger -> HuggingFace API call -> 503 detector -> 30s Wait node retry loop -> code output parser.
